sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 240. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Blinds for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK and MATK by 120% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases ATK buff limit by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases MATK buff limit by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 25 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies iron wall for 60 seconds.
Water Unison damage Ability Power boosted by 40 when equipped in the Main Slot.
